title: The 10 Best Spirit Levels
subtitle: Torpedo, 24-inch and long spirit levels and level sets, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A level tells you when something is truly flat or plumb, from a picture frame to a deck ledger. We ranked 10 best-sellers from STABILA, CRAFTSMAN, ARROW, Franklin Sensors, Amazon Basics and value brands on rating, review volume and features (a magnetic edge, an aluminum frame, a 45-degree vial, 24 inches or longer and a stated accuracy).
data_source: Amazon product listings on the data_captured date. Prices, ratings and review counts change daily; check the listing before relying on a number.

avoid.name: URASISTO 5-Piece Spirit Level Set, 10, 16, 24, 32 and 48-Inch (YST040919)
avoid.flag: Claims accuracy 12 times better than STABILA's
avoid.verdict: A five-level set that claims an accuracy no ordinary bubble level reaches.
reasons: It claims 'maximum accuracy of 0.0005-inch/ft', about 0.04 mm per meter. STABILA, which builds some of the most accurate levels sold, certifies its Pro levels to 0.5 mm per meter.
The same claim appears word for word on URASISTO's 3-piece set, so it reads as copy, not a measured spec.
It's rated 4.4 stars on 191 reviews. The ARROW 3-piece set costs less and doesn't oversell its accuracy.

buyers_guide.a: A 9- to 12-inch torpedo level handles pictures, shelves and appliances. 24 inches suits cabinets and windows. 48 inches is for framing, doors and decks, where a short level misses bows.
Good spirit levels are accurate to about 0.5 to 1 mm per meter. Check a level by reading it, flipping it end for end on the same spot and reading again; the bubble should sit the same.
Magnets hold the level on steel studs, pipe, conduit and machinery, leaving both hands free. They're no help on wood.
A pitch vial reads slope, typically 1/8 or 1/4 inch per foot, the range used for drain pipes and gutters.
Digital and light-up levels are easier to read at odd angles and in the dark. Bubble levels never need batteries.
